run_save_encoder_cli: run the save_encoder CLI to extract and save encoder outputs from a trained fairseq model
run_get_avg_pool: run get_avg_pool to compute the average pooled encoder output for a batch of samples
run_main_extraction: run main to load a model ensemble and extract encoder representations for a dataset subset
review_get_avg_pool: review get_avg_pool to understand how encoder outputs are masked and averaged across sequence dimensions
review_main_workflow: review main to understand the full workflow of loading models, iterating batches, and saving encoder outputs
